title: Interdisciplinary Business with Engineering Studies, B.S. (Behrend)
notes: Built from Behrend's 2022-23 bulletin via bulletin_scraper.py. Identical to 2023 in all required courses and options, except scraper flagged CAS 100 as unverified (the course link did not resolve against the real catalog in 2022). All other verified_codes match 2023 exactly. Total credits: 127 (confirmed by scraper), plus 6cr of added real prereq-chain courses (see below). CAS 100 kept as-is since it appears in the bulletin and only the link verification failed; actual course may exist under a different catalog entry or deprecation pattern. REVIEWER FIX (2026-09): confirmed via planner_engine catalog that CHEM 110 real-requires MATH 22, which itself real-requires MATH 21, and ACCTG 211/SCM 200 real-require MATH 21 -- none of which appear in this bulletin's own suggested plan (same catalog-wide gap as this session's IBBH/IEBH/2026-IBE fixes). Added MATH 21 + MATH 22 to Semester 1 (build_full_plan's own prereq-aware scheduler reorders items into the correct real terms regardless of which JSON semester they're declared under, confirmed by re-running self-verification). This resolves CHEM 110/ACCTG 211/SCM 200/SCM 301/MGMT 410/MGMT 475W/MGMT 476's scheduling. Two items remain genuinely unschedulable and are NOT fixed here since fixing them would require fabricating an alternate option this year's real bulletin doesn't offer: EET 101 has a real concurrent MATH 81 requirement (a developmental-math course this major's MATH 140/141 track never includes), and MET 213 hard-requires MET 111, which itself requires MATH 81/26 (also never in this track) -- 2024+ bulletins added EE 211/EMCH 213 as real alternates that route around this, but the 2022-2023 bulletin's own suggested plan lists EET 101 and MET 213 with no alternate, so this is an honest, disclosed real curriculum gap, not a build bug.
